text: The architecture doc says the sweep forces one review pass per category, but the implementation appends all categories to one model request. Describe the single-pass behavior to match the product contract.
rationale: Real doc/code mismatch: the architecture doc described one pass per category while the implementation appends all categories to one request. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
